candidates.title: Local voice dictation for client notes

demandEvidence.chore: Record speech with a key press, transcribe it, and paste the text.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Press and hold a key to record, release to transcribe and paste the text

ease.reason: A small test can transcribe operator-recorded samples, but no supplied implementation reference documents dictation.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent consultants may pay for private note transcription; the showcase post proves no buyer demand or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock could transcribe a few synthetic or operator-provided clips; Linux setup and accuracy are unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed record-transcribe-paste loop repeats, but recording controls, transcription and accuracy lack implementation evidence.

evidence.reason: The maker describes local voice dictation and its press-release-paste interaction; no independent use or customer evidence is supplied.

candidates.reason: The post describes a maker project, not an external professional-services request; a bounded dictation experiment is assessable but demand and implementation support are absent.
